scope.input: deposited GSE39582 expression matrix, used as-is (Phase 7A Rank 1)

methodological_posture.rationale: QC metric distributions were deliberately NOT computed before writing this specification. Choosing a numeric cutoff by looking at the distribution it is meant to screen is circular. Where no literature-justified constant exists, a DATA-ADAPTIVE rule (Tukey) is pre-specified instead, and the ACTION remains investigation pending approval.

inapplicable_metrics.GNUSE: requires fRMA; not used under Rank 1
inapplicable_metrics.NUSE / RLE: require probe-level PLM fits from CEL files
inapplicable_metrics.note: These are standard Affymetrix QC metrics that CANNOT be computed from an already RMA-normalised, ComBat-adjusted matrix. Their absence is a limitation of the approved input, not an oversight.

tiers.HARD_EXCLUSION: Deterministic integrity failure where the sample or data is DEMONSTRABLY INVALID. May trigger automatic halt or rejection ONLY under both conditions: (a) the failure is deterministic - no threshold judgement is involved; and (b) the invalidity is demonstrable, not inferred. Hard exclusions must NOT be broadened beyond the 9 criteria listed.
tiers.SOFT_INVESTIGATION: pre-specified data-adaptive flag; triggers INVESTIGATION. Exclusion requires explicit written approval
tiers.DESCRIPTIVE: reported only; NEVER independently triggers exclusion

criteria.metric: count of non-finite values in the sample's column
criteria.rule: exclude if count > 0
criteria.justification: a non-finite value is not a measurement; no threshold judgement is involved
criteria.effect_on_frozen: none expected - currently 0 across all 585 samples

criteria.metric: sample_id present in the frozen Phase 3 cohort_membership.csv
criteria.rule: a sample absent from the frozen manifest is not analysable
criteria.justification: cohort membership is frozen (Phase 1/3); QC cannot add samples

criteria.metric: exactly-duplicated sample columns (bitwise identical vectors)
criteria.rule: flag any duplicate pair; investigate provenance; exclude at most one after approval
criteria.justification: an exact duplicate indicates a processing or deposit error, not biology

criteria.metric: non-tumoural sample present in the analysis cohort
criteria.rule: the 19 non-tumoural mucosa samples must not appear in S3
criteria.justification: deterministic from frozen source_name; analysis is tumour-only
criteria.effect_on_frozen: none - S3 excludes them by construction

criteria.metric: per-array median of log2 expression
criteria.rule: Tukey boxplot-whisker rule: flag values beyond Q3 + 1.5*IQR (or below Q1 - 1.5*IQR) of the metric's own distribution across arrays. This is the outlier convention used by arrayQualityMetrics (Kauffmann et al., Bioinformatics 2009;25(3):415-416). It is DATA-ADAPTIVE, so it can be pre-specified without choosing a numeric cutoff by inspection.
criteria.justification: post-quantile-normalisation, per-array medians should be near-constant; a departure indicates an array that did not normalise as expected
criteria.action: INVESTIGATE ONLY - exclusion PROHIBITED on this flag alone; requires an investigation record and explicit written approval
criteria.effect_on_frozen: exclusion would change the analysis cohort and requires approval

criteria.metric: per-array interquartile range of log2 expression
criteria.rule: Tukey boxplot-whisker rule: flag values beyond Q3 + 1.5*IQR (or below Q1 - 1.5*IQR) of the metric's own distribution across arrays. This is the outlier convention used by arrayQualityMetrics (Kauffmann et al., Bioinformatics 2009;25(3):415-416). It is DATA-ADAPTIVE, so it can be pre-specified without choosing a numeric cutoff by inspection.
criteria.justification: IQR captures dispersion that the median does not; IQRray (Mieczkowski et al., Bioinformatics 2014;30(10):1392-1398) shows IQR-based statistics perform well on normalised data
criteria.action: INVESTIGATE ONLY - exclusion PROHIBITED on this flag alone; requires an investigation record and explicit written approval

criteria.metric: sum of 1 - Spearman correlation to every other array in the analysis cohort
criteria.rule: Tukey boxplot-whisker rule: flag values beyond Q3 + 1.5*IQR (or below Q1 - 1.5*IQR) of the metric's own distribution across arrays. This is the outlier convention used by arrayQualityMetrics (Kauffmann et al., Bioinformatics 2009;25(3):415-416). It is DATA-ADAPTIVE, so it can be pre-specified without choosing a numeric cutoff by inspection.
criteria.justification: the arrayQualityMetrics 'distance between arrays' heatmap statistic; an array unlike all others is a candidate technical outlier
criteria.action: INVESTIGATE ONLY - exclusion PROHIBITED on this flag alone; requires an investigation record and explicit written approval

criteria.metric: PCA on the analysis cohort (centred, not scaled); PC1-PC5 scores and variance explained
criteria.rule: NO numeric outlier rule is pre-specified
criteria.justification: no literature-justified PCA outlier threshold exists for this setting. Defining one after seeing the scores would be circular, and PCA structure in this cohort is expected to reflect biology (CMS subtypes) as well as technique
criteria.action: REPORT ONLY - never independently triggers exclusion

criteria.metric: hierarchical clustering dendrogram (correlation distance, average linkage)
criteria.rule: no cut-height rule pre-specified
criteria.justification: same as D-S1; clustering separates biology and technique only with an external label

criteria.metric: batch composition tables and PC-vs-batch association for the 9 recovered ComBat batches
criteria.rule: no threshold; NO batch correction is performed
criteria.justification: batch is confounded with the discovery/validation partition (Cramer's V 0.488, Phase 4). Reporting this is required; correcting it is prohibited

criteria.metric: 3'/5' log2 difference for ACTB (AFFX-HSAC07/X00351) and GAPDH (AFFX-HUMGAPDH/M33197)
criteria.rule: NO threshold applied
criteria.justification: Affymetrix guidance recommends a 3'/5' SIGNAL ratio < 3 for GAPDH and ACTB as an RNA-degradation indicator. That threshold applies to MAS5 signal ratios on the linear scale. Our values are log2, RMA-summarised AND ComBat-adjusted, so the quantity is not the one the threshold was defined for and the constant does NOT transfer. Reported as a relative diagnostic only.
criteria.action: REPORT ONLY - the Affymetrix <3 threshold is explicitly NOT applied

criteria.metric: non-finite values in a probe set / gene row
criteria.rule: any non-finite value is a data-integrity failure
criteria.justification: A non-finite value in a gene row is a data-integrity failure, not a measurement, and no threshold judgement is involved. It is treated as HARD because the value cannot be used; but unlike the sample-level equivalent it ESCALATES rather than excluding, because removing a gene would alter the frozen Phase 2 representations and the frozen M2 member sets, which may not be modified without approval.
criteria.action: ESCALATE - do NOT silently drop. A gene cannot be removed from a frozen representation without approval
criteria.effect_on_frozen: would require reopening a frozen spec; escalate rather than act

criteria.metric: count of zero-variance genes in the analysis cohort
criteria.rule: no cohort-level exclusion
criteria.justification: zero-variance handling is already FROZEN in the M2 scoring specification: sigma=0 genes are excluded PER FOLD from the score, and the exclusion is recorded. A cohort-level removal would both duplicate and contradict that frozen rule

criteria.metric: distribution of per-gene mean and SD; count below candidate low-expression cutoffs
criteria.rule: NO expression filter is applied
criteria.justification: no expression filter has ever been approved for this project (Phase 2 §2). Applying one now would change the frozen representations and the M2 member sets
criteria.action: REPORT ONLY - filtering PROHIBITED without approval
criteria.effect_on_frozen: NONE - no filter is applied. Applying an expression filter would change which genes exist in the frozen Phase 2 representations and which members survive in the frozen M2 panels; prohibited without explicit approval.

criteria.metric: inventory of AFFX control probe sets inside the frozen representations
criteria.rule: no removal
criteria.justification: Phase 7A found 10 AFFX control probe sets across ACTB, GAPDH and STAT1 in the frozen median representation, and that representative-IQR selected two 5' DEGRADATION CONTROLS as the representative probes for ACTB and GAPDH. The frozen specifications are immutable; this is documented, not corrected
criteria.action: REPORT ONLY + carry as an M3 limitation
criteria.effect_on_frozen: NONE - removal would reopen a frozen decision

criteria.metric: probe-to-gene mapping summary (unique / ambiguous / unmapped)
criteria.rule: no action
criteria.justification: already established and frozen in Phase 2 (43,163 unique / 2,619 ambiguous / 8,893 unmapped). Re-reported for completeness
criteria.effect_on_frozen: NONE - the mapping is already frozen in Phase 2 (43,163 unique / 2,619 ambiguous / 8,893 unmapped) and is re-reported only for completeness.

criteria.metric: the frozen Phase 3 bundle's sample-ID set is a SUBSET of the deposited expression matrix, with zero bundle IDs missing
criteria.rule: every frozen-bundle sample must be present in the matrix under an exactly matching identifier; any bundle ID absent from the matrix HALTS QC. Matrix-only samples are expected (non-S0 by construction) and are NOT a failure
criteria.justification: Alignment is by identifier, never position (Phase 3 section 4.2). The Phase 3 bundle is S0-scoped by design, so set equality with the 585-array deposited matrix was never achievable; the property that guarantees integrity is that no bundle sample is missing or renamed.
criteria.superseded_metric: sample-ID set equality between the expression matrix and the frozen Phase 3 bundle
criteria.superseded_rule: must be exactly equal; any mismatch halts QC

criteria.metric: discovery/validation membership matches partition_and_batch.csv
criteria.rule: must match exactly
criteria.justification: partition is frozen; QC cannot reassign samples

criteria.metric: S3 membership equals the frozen cohort_membership.csv (n=453)
criteria.rule: must match exactly
criteria.justification: S3 is frozen (Phase 1); QC cannot change cohort definition

criteria.metric: GSM972262 is excluded under the frozen complete-case strategy
criteria.rule: must be absent from the complete-case analysis set and present in the exclusion record
criteria.justification: A-19 frozen: the sole complete-case exclusion, documented by sample ID and missing variable (chemotherapy.adjuvant = N/A)

prohibited_actions: changing the S3 cohort based on model performance
removing genes for weak outcome association
applying an expression filter without approval
silently removing or replacing AFFX control probes

affx_sensitivity_analysis.specification: IF an M3 result materially implicates ACTB, GAPDH or STAT1, repeat that analysis with the three AFFX-derived genes removed and report both results side by side, clearly labelled. The frozen representations are NOT modified; the removal happens in the sensitivity analysis only.
affx_sensitivity_analysis.trigger: ONLY if M3 materially implicates a gene affected by the identified AFFX representative-probe limitation (ACTB, GAPDH, STAT1).
affx_sensitivity_analysis.reporting_requirement: BOTH analyses reported - primary and sensitivity - clearly labelled
affx_sensitivity_analysis.primary_representation: PRESERVED - the frozen representation is not modified
affx_sensitivity_analysis.anti_rescue_clause: The sensitivity analysis must NOT be used to rescue an unfavourable result. If the primary analysis is unfavourable and the sensitivity analysis is favourable, BOTH are reported and the primary remains primary. Running it selectively, or reporting only the more favourable of the two, is prohibited.

unresolved_requiring_approval: Whether any SOFT_INVESTIGATION flag may lead to exclusion, and on what written justification
Whether a numeric threshold should be adopted for S-S1/S-S2/S-S3 after the distributions are seen (would require a second approval and must not be set to achieve a desired exclusion)
Whether the AFFX sensitivity analysis is triggered (conditional on M3 results)

threshold_immutability.rule: All 20 criteria and their current thresholds are PRESERVED. Thresholds must NOT be changed after observing QC distributions.
change_requires: a written record of what was observed before the change was proposed
threshold_immutability.prohibited: adjusting any threshold once the QC distributions have been seen, without the documented decision and approval above. A threshold changed after inspection is no longer pre-specified.

conditions_both_required: the failure is deterministic (no threshold judgement)
the sample/data integrity is demonstrably invalid
hard_exclusion_scope.note: H-S3 (duplicate columns) and H-G1 (non-finite gene row) do NOT exclude automatically: H-S3 investigates first, H-G1 escalates. Automatic action is confined to criteria where invalidity is self-evident.

soft_flag_policy.explicit_prohibition: No sample may be excluded SOLELY because it crosses a Tukey 1.5 x IQR fence, or appears unusual in PCA, clustering, per-array median, per-array IQR, or between-array distance. Crossing a fence is a reason to look, never a reason to exclude.
soft_flag_policy.exclusion_pathway: soft flag -> individual investigation record (see investigation_record_template) -> STOP and request explicit approval -> exclusion only if approved

investigation_record_template.required_when: a soft-flagged sample is PROPOSED for exclusion

required_fields.description: which criterion fired, the observed value, and the fence it crossed
dataset partition, ComBat batch, stage, and other recorded characteristics
any evidence of technical invalidity independent of the flag itself; state explicitly if NONE exists
whether the observation could reflect biology rather than technique (e.g. CMS4 stromal phenotype)
resulting n and event counts for every affected cohort - reported for transparency, NEVER used to choose whether to exclude
the proposed action and its scientific justification

investigation_record_template.outcome_guided_selection: PROHIBITED - the effect_on_cohort field is reported for transparency only and must never inform the decision
investigation_record_template.terminal_step: STOP and request explicit approval before any exclusion

preprocessing_decision.decision: deposited GSE39582 expression matrix used AS-IS

revision_history.summary: Initial 20-criterion specification; thresholds set without inspecting QC distributions.

Seven review clarifications C1-C6: thresholds immutable; hard list fixed at 9 and may not be broadened; soft flags cannot exclude; 7-field investigation record required; AFFX sensitivity approved with anti-rescue clause; preprocessing decision preserved.
H-C1 amended from set equality to subset-with-zero-missing, following a specification defect discovered during Phase 7C execution. No threshold changed. No other criterion altered.

amendment.defect: As written, H-C1 required SET EQUALITY between the deposited expression matrix (585 arrays) and the frozen Phase 3 bundle. The Phase 3 bundle is S0-scoped (461) BY DESIGN, so equality was never achievable. The criterion compared artifacts of different scope and halted on a defect in its own wording, not on a data problem.
amendment.original_metric: sample-ID set equality between the expression matrix and the frozen Phase 3 bundle
amendment.original_rule: must be exactly equal; any mismatch halts QC
amendment.corrected_metric: the frozen Phase 3 bundle's sample-ID set is a SUBSET of the deposited expression matrix, with zero bundle IDs missing from the matrix
amendment.corrected_rule: every sample in the frozen bundle must be present in the matrix under an exactly matching identifier; any bundle ID absent from the matrix halts QC. Matrix-only samples are expected and are not a failure.
amendment.rationale: The integrity property that matters is that no frozen-bundle sample is missing or renamed. The 124 matrix-only samples reconcile exactly as non-S0 by construction: 19 non-tumoural mucosa, 97 stage 0/I/IV or missing-stage primary tumours, and 8 stage II-III primary tumours lacking documented RFS (469 - 461 = 8, matching the records documented in Phase 1). The amendment neither broadens nor narrows the hard-criteria list and changes no threshold.

preregistration_invariant: This document is the pre-registration. It is NOT mutated to record that QC ran: 'qc_executed' stays False here, and the fact of execution lives in config/analysis/QC_DECISIONS_RECORD.json and reports/phase7c/. The only permitted change is an APPROVED amendment, recorded in revision_history.
